subject: Problem installing Shiny package on R version 3.0.2 "Frisbee Sailing"

messages.author: 15629754714d0272
messages.subject: Problem installing Shiny package on R version 3.0.2 "Frisbee Sailing"
parts:
Hello,
I need some help with installing Shiny package on the following system:

Ubuntu 12.04 64 bits
R version 3.0.2 "Frisbee Sailing"

When I try to install a Shiny package by running:

sudo su - -c "R -e \"install.packages('shiny', repos='http://cran.rstudio.com/')\""

I tried different repos or even by running install.packages('shiny') in R session as sudo, the package fails to install.
There's no errors, but rather a message that "The downloaded source packages are in '/tmp/....'
and when I try to use it (library(shiny)), I got an error that package was not found.

Now, I did not have same issue and everything worked fine on:

Ubuntu 12.04 64 bits
R version 3.0.1 "Good Sport".

Please, help me see what I am missing here.
Thanks. Timur

messages.subject: Re: Problem installing Shiny package on R version 3.0.2 "Frisbee Sailing"
parts: Long story short, I had to run a number of experiments on digitalocean to see what was the reason and finally I found it - RAM. I used the cheapest droplet with 512 MB and it was not enough looks like for R packages to be installed properly. See my question for details. So, as I already had some stuff installed on my droplet, I just resized it by adding more RAM. It was easy to do and I picked up 1 GB. After that, no more issues. Hope this will save you some time. You would want more RAM to run R any ways.
